description: 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소_구군코드 [flood] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. 하천제방의 설계빈도를 초과하는 홍수가 발생하여 제방붕괴, 제방월류 등 극한의 상황이 발생한다는 가정하에 하천 주변지역의 침수범위, 침수깊이를 나타낸 지도. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. Its tags are 위험, 정보, 행정구역, 홍수위험지도, 하천범람. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
